t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
st: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Said She'd Drown the Baby
st: She Said She'd Drown the Baby

st: Holiday Hell With My Feuding Family

d: Chris and Steve confess to cheating on their girlfriends and Michelle wants to tell her boyfriend she has a mistress. The tension is high on today's Jerry Springer Show!

d: The first time Nancy, Tara and Versell appeared on the show, Nancy was pregnant with Versell's baby. He was cheating on her with Tara and now she's pregnant! Who will go?

t: The Jerry Springer Show: You Won't Marry Your Gay Lover!
st: You Won't Marry Your Gay Lover!

t: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have A Secret For My Man!
st: I Have A Secret For My Man!
